The task explicitly requires "checks that catch cases of non-log-concave densities during the sampling process" (requirement [7Pz7YJ5k]). Disabling check_log_concavity entirely may not satisfy this requirement, even if the rejection sampling mechanism can handle non-log-concave distributions gracefully.

Consider: the requirement appears to ask for explicit detection and reporting of non-log-concave cases, not just algorithmic tolerance. Before proceeding to testing, you may need to either (1) implement an alternative log-concavity check that avoids tangent line extrapolation errors, (2) move the check to initialization only, or (3) document explicitly how the algorithm satisfies the requirement without an explicit check function.
</context_for_action>
